name: ai-content-studio-root
description: AI Content Studio for Brands & Creators - Full Stack Application

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install

scripts.prisma:db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
